reason: The hypothesis directly applies the established approach of aging-induced coherent L12 precipitation in the fcc phase of eutectic HEAs (P12, P24, P29, P33) to the specific problem of dislocation pile-ups at colony interfaces, but the mechanism of precipitates selectively nucleating at interfaces to reduce pile-ups is not stated in any passage and merely rephrases known benefits of precipitation strengthening and interface strengthening (P13, P19). The proposal does not combine findings from different papers into a new idea, transfer to a new alloy, or resolve a conflict; it restates a known intervention with a slightly reframed mechanism.
